# External CAD references

Third-party geometry imported into the mechanical assembly for fit-checking
and renders — not authored in this project, not exports of it either.
Provenance is incomplete; fill in source/license details below as they're
recalled.

## `4980 NeoKey 1x4 QT.step`

- Used for: fitting the case/switch-plate around the NeoKey 1x4 QT module.
- Source: not recorded.

## `CYD2USB.step`

- Used for: fitting the case around the CYD2USB display board; also used
  in renders.
- Source: not recorded — believed to originate from someone else's FreeCAD
  project (i.e. not an authoritative manufacturer model), used here for
  illustration rather than as a certified fit reference.
